chunks: Which of the two is better: that a man perform salat (prayer) for himself at the beginning of the time, or that he delay a little and perform salat (prayer) with the people of his mosque if he is their Imam?
He (عليه السلام) said: "He should delay and perform salat (prayer) with the people of his mosque if he is the Imam."

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous or preferable in ruling
key_terms.أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ: the beginning of the prescribed time for salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the one leading the congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.بِأَهْلِ مَسْجِدِهِ: with the people of his mosque in congregation
key_terms.يُؤَخِّرُ: he delays somewhat from the earliest time

ai.seo_question: Is it better for a mosque Imam to pray at the beginning of the time alone or delay slightly to lead congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal preference regarding congregational salat (prayer). If a man is the Imam of his mosque, it is better for him to delay slightly and lead the people in congregation rather than perform salat (prayer) alone at the earliest time.
